patterns.key_values: desktop reminder utility category; the visible surface is a floating desktop pill parked top-left under the notch, not a strict status-menu dropdown; always-on-top glanceable countdown

borderless brand-styled overlay; capsule ~8-9:1 aspect, radius height/2; detached squircle close button + info capsule with nested time-chip; no native chrome, no traffic lights; brand-green translucent material over wallpaper

signature_moves: A Mac desktop Live Activity: imports the iOS Dynamic-Island / Live-Activity capsule (inset status chip + glanceable countdown + truncated title + compact->expandable morph) and parks it always-visible on the desktop. Where Alcove fused with the physical notch via true-black, DeskMinder does it in BRAND COLOUR - the whole capsule drenched in product green so widget + icon + marketing form one continuous mono-green identity.

Countdown-as-open-loop: persistently surfacing '62 min' exploits the Zeigarnik/goal-gradient effect - an unfinished timer nags working memory, which IS the 'for people who get easily distracted' pitch. Built to be glanced, not read.
defects: Brand-tinted material over native glass grammar - saturated brand green as the whole container instead of neutral vibrancy with accent reserved for one action. Systematic + purposeful + no hard a11y break -> signature-with-caveat, EXCLUDED from macOS canon (lineage gate).

Contrast Dilution - 'Reminder...' muted green on green (<4.5:1 est.) AND dark-green pill on green wallpaper (~2:1 est.); green-on-green undercuts the glanceability the pill exists for (Von Restorff: the one different thing must break its surround).
No system-accent binding (controlAccentColor ignored) - defensible for a branded HUD but where the native reading diverges.
Evidence poverty (not a design defect): 1 surface / 1 state from a 1x marketing render - no expanded state, no 'one click' creation flow, no settings/onboarding, no non-green-desktop robustness.

aesthetic.direction: iOS Live-Activity transplant in a single committed brand hue - a consumer-utility surface outside the range-map families; the marketing wrapper is separately a Committed single-hue field (heavy black grotesk wordmark + mint ground + glossy Liquid-Glass-style icon)

psychology: Zeigarnik effect / Goal-gradient (Hull; Kivetz) - a persistent visible countdown keeps an open loop salient in working memory; the core mechanic, well matched to the distraction-fighting pitch

Von Restorff / signal-detection theory - a glanceable widget must break its surround to be found; brand-green-on-green wallpaper nearly matches it, weakening the pop (contrast-dependent, wallpaper-dependent)
Miller/Cowan chunking + progressive disclosure - the collapsed pill shows only 2 chunks (time + label), reserving detail for an expanded state; good reduction
Jakob's Law - borrowing the iOS Live-Activity form means users arrive pre-trained on the pill's meaning; familiarity is the affordance
Fitts's Law - detached ~24px close target sits at the WCAG 24px floor; fine for pointer-first desktop, small for anything touch-adjacent
notes: Only a cover.jpg (marketing composite) and an icon.webp were supplied - no dedicated UI shots. Workflow A run on the sole app-UI evidence: the floating reminder pill embedded in the composite. Everything is a 1x downscaled render, so ALL metrics are (estimated) with wide ranges and NO pt sizes are recoverable - scores are soft and several rubric/native checks are N/A on a single borderless custom widget. Nearest corpus peer is Alcove (same Dynamic-Island-transplant idea); DeskMinder differs by using brand colour instead of true-black and parking on the desktop rather than the notch. Lineage native but custom-drawn brand surface -> does NOT feed macOS canon. Icon (gauge/dial in a glossy green squircle) and heavy-grotesk wordmark are brand evidence only, not app-UI tokens. Website deskminder.appps.od.ua indicates a real shipped app, not a mock.
